Recovery Timelines

Recommended recovery periods by race distance

5K5 days
J1-J2

Complete rest or light walking only

J3

Very easy 20-25 min jog in Z1

J4-J5

Progressive return, normal easy run possible

10K7 days
J1-J3

Rest or light cross-training (walking, easy cycling)

J4-J5

Easy 25-30 min jog in Z1

J6-J7

Normal return, first quality session possible after day 7

Half-marathon14 days
J1-J3

Complete rest, walking only

J4-J7

Very light 20-30 min jog every other day

J8-J10

Daily easy jog, progressive volume

J11-J14

Gradual return to quality sessions

Marathon30 days
J1-J14

No running. Walking, swimming, light cycling OK after day 3-4.

J15-J21

Resume jogging in Z1, 20-30 min max, every other day

J22-J30

Progressive volume increase. First light quality session possible at end of period.
